reason_no_execution: The only frozen SRF protocol explicitly excludes historical assembly prioritization and its runner cannot consume these historical FASTQ inputs under its frozen contract. Running now would create a post-hoc historical protocol rather than execute a preregistered endpoint.

existing_native_output.reason: This run used the orthogonal-audit rule: 43 eligible-only families, 250-kb templates, minimap2 map-hifi with -N 5, primary-only filtering, minimum 500-bp block, minimum 0.75 identity, and exclusion of multi-family reads. It has no retained command, executable/source fingerprint, stderr, wall-time or RSS receipt and does not match the formal simulation competitive-mapping rule.

blocking_gaps: The frozen SRF unified protocol explicitly says historical prioritization is not run and evaluates generated single-FASTA simulation datasets only.

The frozen SRF runner accepts one uncompressed FASTA and calculates bases with FASTA parsing; the historical inputs are gzip FASTQ and Macadamia is two files. No immutable conversion, concatenation, read-ID collision, order or converted-input hash contract exists.
No historical SRF-to-TandemX family/HOR correspondence threshold, ambiguity rule or unassigned-abundance rule is frozen.
No historical normalization from SRF native mapped-read bp to genomic estimated bp is frozen for 18.637-Gb Ey15 or 22.546-Gb Macadamia libraries.

Two incompatible mapping rules exist: formal simulation uses the whole TandemX catalogue tandemized to 10 kb with minimap2 -N1000000 -f1000 -r100,100, whereas the Macadamia orthogonal audit uses only 43 eligible families tandemized to 250 kb with -N5 and additional primary, length, identity and multi-family filters.

The current endpoint evaluator marks nonpositive estimates N/A, while the formal simulation contract allows valid empty native output to score zero abundance. This changes endpoint denominators and must be fixed before inspection.

The formal simulation stage cap is 180 seconds and the global launch cap is 45 minutes, whereas prior historical read quantification stages took approximately 9495 to 11293 seconds. No historical resource cap is frozen.

The internal filesystem does not have enough headroom for a safe copy of all compressed reads plus unbounded KMC temporary and retained native outputs. The main task subsequently reported a successful read-only ExFAT verification and healthy T7 remount, restoring a writable large-output route; this removes the storage block but does not supply the missing historical execution contract.

acquisition_and_staging.safe_staging_basis: Main task reported fsck_exfat exit 0 and a healthy T7 remount after this source audit; T7 has sufficient reported free space for a bounded run.

minimum_unblocking_actions: Freeze a dedicated historical protocol before inspecting new native output. It must resolve FASTQ ingestion/order, SRF-to-TandemX family/HOR correspondence, zero and ambiguous states, read-to-genome normalization, the full-versus-eligible mapping catalogue choice, exact minimap2 filters, and full-read resource caps.
Use the now-verified T7 route only after the dedicated historical protocol has been frozen; retain a bounded KMC/output preflight and explicit output root.
Run and retain four SRF cells and two formal competitive-mapping cells with input, protocol, source, binary, command, stderr, wall, CPU, RSS, temporary-disk and output-hash receipts.

Score the frozen 19 Ey15 and 43 Macadamia source-eligible families while preserving unavailable, ambiguous and unmatched states. Report agreement with the retrospective newer-assembly proxy, not accuracy against physical truth.
interpretation_boundary: The existing TandemX confusion matrices are retrospective agreement with the same newer-assembly proxy used to define the labels. They are bookkeeping against that proxy, not population accuracy, independent copy-number truth, or comparator superiority.
